note: One row of the window's rail (VPP rework 2026-11-12): a module, or a page of an open module. The script creates one per module and per page into Rail, renames the root 'rail:<n>' and writes the caption into RailRowText; RailRowBar marks the open page, RailRowMark is a module's chevron. A button root holds page content instead of the Edge/Bg/Text idiom a nested button gets, so the children are written out here.

panel.name: RailRowBg
panel.note: The pick colour while the row is the open page; the rail's own colour otherwise.

label.name: RailRowText
label.note: Module rows in capitals; page rows indented by the script.
